findings.summary: No single declaration states the whole lemma: (8.26) is a generic identity, (8.27) is RankGeometry.debt_eq_remainders, and the class gain is rankStage_gain_of_targets. All three concern the same objects and together cover every clause.

The paper's support-local form is proved but not consumed. rankStage_gain_of_targets has no callers; the main chain uses MovingMomentBounds.rankStage_defectBounds, with base bounds on the whole strip and increment bounds supplied separately.

Judge-added. Three paper hypotheses have no Lean counterpart: the lower bound a_0, divergence-freeness of (β,v,γ), and the bound on V. Lean instead makes standing setup explicit (OperatorBounds, W shell-supported, patch strictly inside the gauge shell).
